description: Before onboarding or a large payment: GET /risk for the address plus its recent counterparties (Base USDC transfers in the last 100k blocks, Ethereum last 50 ERC-20 transfers) screened against OFAC SDN, Circle/Tether freeze lists and exploit/phishing/mixer labels. Returns verdict, exposure level, flagged counterparties with a sample tx, and coverage. Price: $0.05 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.
name: sanctions_deep
